newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was very slow in the panhandle area late Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested at the close.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 100 slaughter heifers; 13,100 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 12,200 formulated and 300 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Heifers - pen select and choice 2-3 1100 lbs 69.00.
Wk to Date: 13,100 Week Ago: 81,700 Year Ago: 17,600
